title: Practice 1: Dates and years in real sentences

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Да, мне приснился тогда этот сон, мой сон третьего ___ (ноябрь)!
exercises.why: Dates and years in real sentences — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 73, 75.  ·  «In denoting the time of an event (in answering the question "when?") the date and the month are both in the Genitive case.» — DLI, Lesson 75.
